# .github/

CI workflows, generated Copilot-CLI mirrors, and agent prompts, consumed by GitHub Actions and Copilot CLI inside this repo.

## Matters

- Generated, never hand-edit: `instructions/*.instructions.md` and `agents/*.agent.md` (ADR-109 B1) regenerate with `build/scripts/build_all.py`; `prompts/pr-quality-gate-*.md` regenerates only with `build/scripts/generate_pr_quality_prompts.py`, which `build_all.py` does not run; lefthook pre-push `review-axis-drift` and the `Review-axes drift check` step of the required `Validate Generated Files` job block a stale copy. Sources: Where to look.
- `copilot-instructions.md`: Copilot's always-on entry point (CLI, VS Code, Visual Studio). `scripts/validate_workspace_budget.py` declares a 6351-byte ceiling (4707 today) and nothing runs that script as a gate, but `tests/test_workspace_limits.py::test_per_file_limit` asserts the live file against the same constant inside the required `Run Python Tests` check, and `scripts/test_selection/path_policy.yml`'s `**/*.md` (repo root, not a `.github/` file) means editing this file triggers that matrix. The ceiling is hard. Separate from the 2000-token cap on root `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`, which `passive-context-budget.yml` enforces.
- Before touching an agent, prompt, instruction, or hook file shared with Copilot CLI: read `agent-harness-reference` first, route the change through `ai-agents-portability-campaign`.
- No merge queue on `main`. A repo-root `scripts/ci/` count ratchet passes at or below baseline and tolerates the baseline sitting up to `MAX_BASELINE_SLACK = 6` above the tree, which is what keeps concurrent cleanup PRs from redding `main` (issue #4057, PR #4214); past six it blocks and demands a true-up commit.

## Entry points

- `workflows/pr-validation.yml`: required check every PR runs (PR body shape, commit count, ADR-006 scan, rule `paths:` keys, bare-`python3` doc entrypoints, memory-index token ratchet).
- `copilot-instructions.md`: loaded into every Copilot CLI session here.
- `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`: body shape `pr-validation.yml` checks every PR against.
- Repo-root `scripts/ci/*.py` (105) and `scripts/*.py` here (18) carry most workflow job logic (ADR-006), not all: of 173 distinct script paths the workflows invoke, 80 sit outside both, 34 under `scripts/validation/` and 14 under `build/scripts/`. Grep the workflow rather than assume a directory. There is no `.github/scripts/ci/`.

## Where to look

| Path | Why |
|---|---|
| `workflows/*.yml` | Hand-edited; schema/SHA-pin checked by `validate_workflows.py` in `pr-validation.yml` |
| `agents/*.agent.md` | Rendered from `templates/agents/<stem>.copilot.md.tmpl` (`build/generate_agents.py`, not under `build/scripts/` unlike every other generator named here; `github` platform, ADR-109 B1) |
| `agents/security/references/*.md` | Hand-maintained byte copy of `src/claude/security/references/`; no template, no generator, no parity gate. Backs `security.agent.md`; edit both copies. `.github/agents/` is in `build_all.py` `OWNED_PREFIXES`, so an uncommitted edit here reds `build_all.py --check` as "regen drift"; commit first |
| `agents/pr-comment-responder.prompt.md` | The one `.prompt.md` under `agents/` (`prompts/` has ten more): hand-maintained slash-command entry, no template, no generator. Pinned by `tests/test_pr_comment_responder_status_greps.py` and `tests/test_pr_comment_responder_check_envelope.py` |
| `instructions/*.instructions.md` | Generated by `generate_rules.py` from `.claude/rules/*.md` (`paths:`->`applyTo:`); plugin mirror skips internal-only-scoped rules |
| `prompts/*.md` | `pr-quality-gate-*.md` (12) generated from `.claude/skills/review/references/*.md`; `pr-quality.*.prompt.md` (7) is a separate hand-written set, dot not hyphen, and `CODEOWNERS` pins both spellings. Rest hand-written (spec checks, triage, drift issue, synthesis) |
| `copilot-instructions.md`, `copilot-code-review.md` | Copilot entry point; AI-reviewer volume/confidence rules |
| `scripts/*.py` (18) | Workflow helper modules; most other job modules are at repo-root `scripts/ci/` (105) and `scripts/validation/` (127). Tests at repo-root `tests/`, not `.github/tests/` |
| `actions/` | Composite actions consumed by workflows above |
| `plugin/marketplace.json`, `copilot/settings.json`, `codeql/*.yml` | Copilot marketplace entry, CLI settings, CodeQL config |
| `CODEOWNERS`, `labeler.yml`, `bot-authors.yml` | Owner review gates, path-based PR labels, bot-actor identification |

## Skip

- `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: unread by automation. `FUNDING.yml`: read only by `labeler.yml`'s area-infrastructure rule.
- `CLAUDE.md`: claude-mem stub that imports this file via `@AGENTS.md`. The `<claude-mem-context>` block is tool-written; leave it.

## Constraints

- SHA pinning: `git_hook_policy.py staged-action-pins` locally, `scripts/validate_workflows.py` in `pr-validation.yml` remotely (`security.md` MUST-4).
- New concurrency groups register in `measure_workflow_coalescing.py`'s `DEFAULT_WORKFLOWS`, use `cancel-in-progress: true`; coalescing is best-effort (over 20% duplicate runs is a bug, ADR-026).
- `gh` calls in `scripts/*.py` name the repository: build the path as `repos/{owner}/{repo}/...` and expose `--repo`/`--repository`. Those flags default to empty and fall back to the git remote, so the API path, not the flag, is what pins the target.

## Dangerous assumptions

- "SHA pinning enforced by `check_ci_dependency_pins.py`": wrong. That checks `pkg==version` pins against `pyproject.toml`, not Action SHAs.
- "`instruction-budget.yml` caps root `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`": wrong. It gates the always-on rule corpus per language. Root doc cap (2000 tokens, 4000 on `.claude/CLAUDE.md`) is `passive-context-budget.yml`.
- `agents/*.agent.md` looks hand-maintained; it is generated (ADR-109 B1) from `templates/agents/<stem>.copilot.md.tmpl`. Edit the template, not the output.
- Green `validate-generated-agents.yml`/`agent-drift-detection.yml` on a PR touching no agent file proves nothing: both skip behind an internal paths filter, and the latter also skips on `[skip-drift-check]` in any commit message. A PR check reading `Agent Drift Detection` is that workflow; `drift-detection.yml` carries the same `name:` but is cron-only, no PR trigger.

## Dependencies

- What `detect_agent_drift.py` catches versus misses: see build/AGENTS.md. `workflows/drift-detection.yml` runs it on a weekly cron and files an issue; it never fails a check and is not a required context. The `Install-parity check` step in the required `Validate Generated Files` job is inert since ADR-109 B1 (`validate_install_parity.py` cannot return a violation; build/AGENTS.md); `build_all.py --check` in the same job is what catches a stale tree.
- `pr-validation.yml` overlaps `scripts/validation/pre_pr.py` on 9 of the 20 scripts it invokes. `adr006_run_block_scanner.py` and `check_python3_entrypoints.py` run in neither `pre_pr.py` nor lefthook, and `validate_workflows.py` is a lefthook job only, so a green `pre_pr.py` does not predict a green `Validate PR`.
- `copilot-instructions.md`, `instructions/*.instructions.md`: what Copilot CLI loads. No effect on Claude Code, which reads `.claude/rules/*.md` directly.

## Architecture

- `agents/*.agent.md` is one of five agent output trees fed by `templates/agents/`; per-tree render path: `templates/AGENTS.md`.
- `prompts/pr-quality-gate-*.md`: one-way generation edge from `.claude/skills/review/references/`. Stale output is blocked by lefthook pre-push `review-axis-drift` (`generate_pr_quality_prompts.py --dry-run`) and by the `Review-axes drift check` step (`run_drift_check_ci.py`) in the required `Validate Generated Files` job, not by `build_all.py --check`. `CODEOWNERS` assigns both ends to one owner; code-owner review is not required on `main`.

## Commands

```bash
# ADR-006 run-block scan
uv run python scripts/ci/adr006_run_block_scanner.py --max 0
# Workflow schema + action SHA-pin check
uv run python scripts/validate_workflows.py
# Regenerate Copilot instruction mirrors
uv run python build/scripts/generate_rules.py
# Regenerate pr-quality-gate prompts
uv run python build/scripts/generate_pr_quality_prompts.py
# Agent drift, weekly cron equivalent. Exits 1 on drift (merge-resolver is already drifted at HEAD); scripts/ci/drift_run_detection.py maps that 1 to 0 and files an issue rather than failing the run
uv run python build/scripts/detect_agent_drift.py --fail-on-install-drift
# Verify (never write) every OWNED_PREFIXES tree, agents/*.agent.md included; drop --check to actually regenerate. Does not cover prompts/
uv run python build/scripts/build_all.py --check
# copilot-instructions.md byte ceiling; the enforcing gate is tests/test_workspace_limits.py under the required Run Python Tests
uv run python scripts/validate_workspace_budget.py
# Root doc token cap, then the always-on instruction corpus
uv run python -m scripts.validation.passive_context_budget --ci
uv run python -m scripts.validation.instruction_budget --ci
# Full pre-push gate
uv run python scripts/validation/pre_pr.py
```
